name: nightly-eval-gate
description: A cron-driven quality heartbeat: every night it runs the eval suite (nests eval-pipeline) and routes on the result — a regression opens a ticket and pages owners, a clean run is recorded. The unattended backstop that catches quality drift between releases, so regressions are found by the system at 3am rather than by users at noon.

phases.name: run-evals
phases.description: Run the eval suite against the current build (nested orchestration).

phases.name: gate-on-result
phases.description: Did the eval suite regress versus the expected baseline?

phases.name: summarize-regression
phases.description: Summarize which evals regressed and by how much.

phases.name: file-ticket
phases.description: Open a ticket for the regression and page the owners.

clean.name: record-pass
clean.description: All evals within tolerance — record the green run.

default.name: human-review
default.description: Ambiguous eval result — a human looks.
